data.name: Boyd
data.gender_notes: Boyd is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Originally from the Scottish Gaelic name 'Bodach', meaning 'young man' or 'boy'. The name is derived from the Old English 'bodga', meaning 'to serve' or 'to be a guardian'. The name Boyd carries the meaning “Little Boy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Boyd usually hope their child will grow to embody little boy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes bravery, strength, and protection. It is a name for a boy who is destined to be a guardian and protector, and who will grow up to be strong and brave.
data.etymology: Boyd belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Boy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Boyd total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
